verdict.rationale: Evidence pack contains only generic marketing about AI PCs, Copilot+, oneAPI/oneDNN optimizations and gaming features — no memory capacity, addressable RAM, or memory-bandwidth specifications are published anywhere in the pack that would show whether a 70B-class quantized model could actually fit or run at usable speed. Missing for 10: published RAM/VRAM capacity limits, memory bandwidth (GB/s) figures, and any hands-on/benchmark evidence of running a 70B-class quantized LLM on this platform.
